scenarios.desc: An agent wants to fix a typo in a generated SKILL.md
scenarios.input: There is a typo in src/claude/skills/build/SKILL.md. How do I fix it? Answer in 4 short bullets. Do not run anything.
scenarios.rationale: The skill says generated files are never hand-edited: edit the template source and run build_all.py. A response that routes the fix to the template and the build is attributable to the skill.

scenarios.desc: An agent finished a template edit and wants to commit
scenarios.input: I edited templates/skills/test.SKILL.md.tmpl. What must I do before I commit? Answer in 4 short bullets. Do not run anything.
expected_signals: commit the template and its output together
scenarios.rationale: The skill requires running build_all.py, running it a second time to prove the output is clean, and committing template and output together. A response naming that sequence is attributable to the skill.
